precision.display: display_value = value * display_scale; percentunit uses scale 100
precision.missing: Explicit nulls retain rows; absent points create no rows; no interpolation or zero filling

identity: Snapshot keys identify stored display points; names are not identifiers; IDs are scoped to this run
